Obesity-Associated Cardiovascular Risk and Benefit From PCSK9 Inhibition: A Prespecified Analysis From FOURIER. The PCSK9 inhibitor evolocumab decreases the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). The relationship between body mass index (BMI) and benefit of evolocumab remains unknown. This study sought to investigate the association between BMI, risk of MACE, and the clinical benefit of evolocumab.
